title: Libre 1 NFC support? What am I missing?
body:
Hello,

[This wiki page](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/wiki/Device-Universe
) states that:
- **Libre**
  - Scan using Phone based NFC

is supported by xDrip. But I can't make it work in my Android device. I can use LibreLink and Glimp with NFC without problems, but there is no option related to this in the xDrip app.

Thank you very much.

comments.body: So I found out this feature is inside Libre wifi, which is not at all clear to me. Wifi = NFC? Maybe I missed something, so I am closing this.
